CS_CORE_ACCELERATED.title: Core Accelerated Computer Science
CS_CORE_ACCELERATED.summary: Fast-tracked engineering track prioritizing rigorous mathematics, algorithmic problem solving, and competitive programming.
highSchoolFocus: Advanced Calculus, Coordinate Geometry, and Algebra
Foundational Physics and Chemistry for engineering entrances
Competitive programming fundamentals (C++ or Python)
undergradDegrees: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
freeResources: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science (Harvard / edX)

CS_APPLIED_EXPLORATORY.title: Applied Software & Practical Tech
CS_APPLIED_EXPLORATORY.summary: Hands-on software development track emphasizing real-world projects, modern web stacks, and practical application building.
highSchoolFocus: Applied Mathematics and practical computer science electives
Front-end web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
Open-source collaboration and project building
undergradDegrees: B.Sc in Computer Science or Software Development

POLYTECHNIC_DIPLOMA.title: Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering
POLYTECHNIC_DIPLOMA.summary: A practical, laboratory-first technical pathway with direct lateral entry into the 2nd year of B.Tech.
highSchoolFocus: POLYCET entrance exam preparation
Hands-on electronics, computing, or mechanical workshops
Core technical foundation subjects
undergradDegrees: Lateral Entry into B.Tech 2nd Year (via ECET)
freeResources: State Board of Technical Education curriculum notes

VOCATIONAL_SELF_PACED.title: Vocational & Applied Technical Track
VOCATIONAL_SELF_PACED.stream: Vocational Stream / National Skills Qualification Framework
VOCATIONAL_SELF_PACED.summary: Cost-effective, highly applied track focusing on rapid skill acquisition and direct entry into tech support or junior development.
highSchoolFocus: Computer operations and basic system administration
Practical coding and database fundamentals
Apprenticeship preparation
undergradDegrees: B.Voc (Bachelor of Vocation) in Software Development

AI_HUMANITIES_HYBRID.title: AI, Design & Cognitive Sciences Hybrid
AI_HUMANITIES_HYBRID.stream: 11th & 12th Humanities / Commerce with Math or Informatics
AI_HUMANITIES_HYBRID.summary: Interdisciplinary track connecting artificial intelligence with human-computer interaction, cognitive psychology, ethics, and digital product design.
highSchoolFocus: Psychology, Economics, and Design thinking electives
Introductory statistics and user research methods
UCEED / NID / CUET entrance exam prep
undergradDegrees: B.Des in Interaction Design / Human-Computer Interaction
B.Sc in Cognitive Science or Digital Humanities

MPC_ENGINEERING.title: MPC (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) — Engineering & Tech Track
MPC_ENGINEERING.summary: The premier foundation for algorithmic thinking, hardware engineering, core sciences, and technical innovation.
highSchoolFocus: Rigorous mastery of Calculus, Linear Algebra, and Coordinate Geometry
Physics: Mechanics, Electromagnetism, and Modern Physics foundations
Entrance prep: JEE Main/Advanced, State CETs (EAMCET, KCET, MHT-CET)
undergradDegrees: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, AI & Machine Learning, or Electronics (ECE)
B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Robotics Engineering
Integrated M.Sc / BS in Data Science or Applied Mathematics

BIPC_MEDICINE.title: BiPC (Biology, Physics, Chemistry) — Medical & Healthcare Track
BIPC_MEDICINE.summary: Targeted pathway for clinical medical sciences, clinical pharmacology, and biological research.
highSchoolFocus: Human Physiology, Genetics, Molecular Biology, and Botany
Organic Chemistry and Basic Biophysics
NEET-UG and AIIMS entrance preparation
undergradDegrees: B.Sc Nursing, Biotechnology, or Allied Health Sciences

PCMB_HYBRID.title: PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology) — Computational Biology Track
PCMB_HYBRID.summary: Combines biological sciences with quantitative modeling, leading directly into Bioinformatics, Genomics, and Bio-AI.
highSchoolFocus: Equal focus on Higher Mathematics and Modern Genetics/Cell Biology
Organic and Physical Chemistry
Preparation for both Engineering (JEE/CET) and Medical/Research (NEET/IISER) tests
undergradDegrees: B.Tech / BS in Bioinformatics or Biomedical Engineering
BS-MS at IISER / IISc in Quantitative Biology

MEC_COMMERCE_DATA.title: MEC (Mathematics, Economics, Commerce) — Fintech & Data Track
MEC_COMMERCE_DATA.summary: Blends commercial logic with analytical math, ideal for quantitative finance, economics, and business analytics.
highSchoolFocus: Applied Mathematics, Statistics, and Financial Accounting
Micro and Macro Economics
CUET, IPMAT (IIM 5-year integrated management), and CA Foundation

CEC_COMMERCE_MANAGEMENT.title: CEC (Commerce, Economics, Civics) — Corporate & Business Management Track
CEC_COMMERCE_MANAGEMENT.summary: Focuses on business administration, corporate operations, law, and organizational leadership without pure calculus pressure.
highSchoolFocus: Commercial Accounting, Auditing, and Corporate Governance
Civics, Indian Constitution, and Economic Policy
CUET and IPMAT preparation

HEC_HUMANITIES_ARTS.title: HEC (History, Economics, Civics) — Humanities, Policy & Law Track
HEC_HUMANITIES_ARTS.summary: The definitive foundation for constitutional law, civil services, international relations, public policy, and creative arts.
highSchoolFocus: Modern & Contemporary World History, Political Systems
Public Policy and Constitutional Law
CLAT (Common Law Admission Test) & CUET preparation
undergradDegrees: B.A. LL.B (5-Year National Law University track)
B.A. (Honours) in Political Science, International Relations, or Economics
B.Des / B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication
